title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models
authors: J. Ainslie, J. Lee-Thorp, M. de Jong, Y. Zemlyanskiy, F. Lebrón, S. Sanghai
before: You chose between multi-head attention, which was accurate but memory-hungry, and multi-query, which was fast but lossy.
problem: Multi-query attention degraded quality; multi-head attention throttled inference.
breakthrough: Share keys and values across small groups of heads, and convert existing checkpoints cheaply.
why: Llama 2, Mistral, Qwen and most models since use it. It is the default attention layout today.
next: DeepSeek's latent attention pushed the same goal further.
inherits: The attention variant in almost every model you will run.
